propositions: Closing a ticket with no file impact in accepted scope unconditionally scans full git history and resolves all historical ticket references before checking if the impact union is empty.
The _check_work_landed function calls _referencing_commits before _check_file_impact_vs_diff, performing discarded work when accepted-ticket/descendant impact is empty.
Adding an early guard based on _union_file_impact(accepted_ids, tracker) prevents commit discovery and related resolver work when accepted scope has no file impact.
Tickets or descendants with declared file impact must continue to invoke full commit discovery and landing enforcement checks.
The fix preserves completion-verifier, administrative-disposition, force, and descendant-credit semantics for all impact-present paths.
